title: Black Pepper and Slow-Cooked Onion Spaghetti
changes_from_base: Onions slow-cooked in olive oil for an hour replace the tomato sauce, finished with tarragon and lots of black pepper.
summary: Spaghetti wrapped in a silky sauce of onions slow-cooked in olive oil for an hour, finished with tarragon and plenty of black pepper.
equipment: large lidded casserole or deep frying pan

ingredients.item: red onion (1 medium), sliced 5 mm thick
fine sea salt or table salt
fine salt for 3 litres of pasta water (0.8%)
ingredients.note: about 4 tsp; most of it goes down the drain

steps.title: Sweat the onions
steps.text: Put the oil and both onions in the casserole over medium heat. When they sizzle, cook 5-7 min until they begin to wilt but have not browned.

steps.title: Slow-cook
steps.text: Stir in the salt, cover, turn the heat to low and cook about 1 h, stirring now and then, until very soft and translucent but still in strands. The lid traps the steam so they turn silky and sweet without colouring; add a spoon of water if they catch.

steps.title: Cook the pasta
steps.text: Boil the spaghetti in 3 litres salted water until al dente. Save about 350 ml of the water and drain.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Add the pasta, the tarragon and about 120 ml of the water to the onions. Turn the heat to medium-high and stir hard for 1-2 min until glossy, adding more water if needed.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Pile into bowls and finish with Parmesan and plenty of black pepper.

tips: Keep the heat low so the onions soften without browning.
Make a double batch of onions; they keep a week and freeze well.
Grind the pepper coarsely for little bursts of heat.
storage: Cool and refrigerate in an airtight container within 2 hours for up to 2 days. Reheat in a pan with a splash of water until piping hot (74 °C).
